note: Goal specifications extracted from the decompiled AS3 client.

goalTypes.trigger: Abstract base class. Every concrete goal is constructed with an integer goal id; the base constructor fetches the localized strings for that id from TranslationGoals and resets the progress counters (_currentStep = 0, _steps = 1).
goalTypes.progressMetric: _currentStep (int) out of _steps (int). Subclasses override the getters or increment _currentStep from an event handler.
goalTypes.completionCondition: isCompleted() returns _currentStep >= _steps. checkComplete() dispatches the 'complete' signal, persists the state and deactivates the goal. Progress is persisted by save(), which queues a 'set_goals' command carrying [visited ? 1 : 0, currentStep].
goalTypes.notes: The reward is NOT decided here: GoalManager.addGoal() parses the third constructor argument of addGoal and assigns it through the rewards setter. Every goal registered in this client is registered with the literal 10, which parseReward() turns into RewardResource(COST_GOLD, 10) - i.e. 10 gold.

goalTypes.trigger: Interface (core/goals/Goal.as). Declares the contract implemented by AbstractGoal; not instantiable.
goalTypes.progressMetric: Declares get currentStep() and get numSteps().
goalTypes.completionCondition: Declares isCompleted(), activate()/deactivate(), initialize(), save(), finish(), resetGoal(), deliverReward().

reward.notes: Not a registered goal type - no reward is ever attached to it.

goalTypes.notes: Interface only - it is not a goal type that can be registered.

goalTypes.trigger: Not a goal. Dynamic data holder for the six localized strings of one goal.
goalTypes.progressMetric: n/a - holds TITLE(0), INTRO(1), DESCRIPTION(2), INSTRUCTIONS(3), HINT(4), COMPLETE(5).
goalTypes.completionCondition: n/a.

reward.notes: Not a registered goal type - no reward is ever attached to it.

goalTypes.notes: Every HINT literal in TranslationGoals.as is an empty string, so the 'hint' field of the goal UI is always blank; the playable instructions live in the INSTRUCTIONS literal.

goalTypes.trigger: Not a goal. Static dictionary of goal texts keyed by goal id (140 entries).
goalTypes.progressMetric: n/a.
goalTypes.completionCondition: n/a.

reward.notes: Not a registered goal type - no reward is ever attached to it.

goalTypes.notes: Contains 6 ids that are never registered as goals (98, 105, 114, 122, 128, 140) and lacks 12 ids that the config does contain (2, 7, 12, 15, 35, 38, 68, 75, 76, 77, 78, 83).

goalTypes.trigger: The generic UI action signal Base.Main.actionTriggered (Signal(int)). Only ACTION_ZOOM (0) and ACTION_MULTISELECT (1) are ever dispatched (core/Base.as:2411, core/Base.as:6737).
goalTypes.progressMetric: Count of actionTriggered events whose action id equals the goal's action id.
goalTypes.completionCondition: _currentStep >= _steps. Goal 6 (LET'S ZOOM!) requires 8 zoom actions.
goalTypes.notes: The action id is matched client-side; the server has to know that zoom (action 0) and multi-select (action 1) are the only dispatched actions to reproduce the counter.

goalTypes.trigger: Not an engine event: the goal fires when the player closes the goal-information popup (AbstractGoal.onPopupclosed, invoked from popups/PopupGoals.as:828, 846, 957).
goalTypes.progressMetric: Binary - _currentStep is set to 1.
goalTypes.completionCondition: Completes the moment the goal info popup is closed. The handler also calls Base.Main.gotoInvite(), which opens the FB invite flow.
goalTypes.notes: Goal 85 (CALL YOUR ALLIES!) is therefore completed by opening the invite dialog, not by an actual alliance being formed.

goalTypes.trigger: Base.Iso.alliesMarketTrade, dispatched by IsoBuilding.collect() when the player collects from the Allies Market (core/isoengine/IsoBuilding.as:1135).
goalTypes.progressMetric: Per-resource cumulative amount received from the Allies Market, matched against the requested amounts (sign-consistent, |received| >= |requested|).
goalTypes.completionCondition: Intended: all requested resource amounts collected. Actual code (GoalAlliesMarketTrade.as:62) computes _currentStep = (param1 < this.tradesLength) ? 0 : 1, comparing an Object to an int. The comparison is always false, so _currentStep is always 1 and the goal completes on the very first Allies-Market collection regardless of the requested amount.
goalTypes.notes: VERIFIED BUG in the original client. Goal 84 (OBTAIN WOOD IN THE ALLIES MARKET, {"w":500}) is therefore completed by a single collection. A faithful re-implementation should decide whether to reproduce the bug.

goalTypes.trigger: Base.Iso.neighbourBuildingAssisted, dispatched when the player helps a neighbour finish a building (core/isoengine/IsoInteractiveElement.as:818).
goalTypes.progressMetric: Count of assist events.
goalTypes.completionCondition: _currentStep >= _steps. Goal 81 (HELP A FRIEND!) requires 5 assists.
goalTypes.notes: The handler does not check that the assisted building belongs to a friend, nor that it is the player's own map.

goalTypes.trigger: Assault.attackEnd, dispatched with {win, opponent, voluntary} when an assault finishes (battle/Assault.as:430-436).
goalTypes.progressMetric: Count of qualifying assaults.
goalTypes.completionCondition: _currentStep >= numAttacks. An event is discarded when param1.voluntary is true (the player aborted the assault - Assault.bVoluntaryEnd is set in popups/PopupAttackFinished.as:491), when victoryNeeded is set and the assault was not won, or when friends is set and the opponent is NOT in the friend list (Base.Main.getAllFriends()).
goalTypes.notes: Goal 52 = attack any player once (any outcome, never an aborted assault). Goal 65 = defeat 3 players (victory required). Goal 57 = defeat 1 friend (victory required AND the opponent must be a friend). The friend test uses param1.opponent.fbid.

goalTypes.trigger: Base.Iso.elementBuilt, dispatched for every finished building (IsoEngine.buildingBuilt) and every finished unit (IsoEngine.unitBuilt) - core/isoengine/IsoEngine.as:571-579.
goalTypes.progressMetric: Count of built elements whose item id is in the goal's id list and whose PlayerID is PLAYER_SELF.
goalTypes.completionCondition: _currentStep >= steps.
goalTypes.notes: updateOnActivate: when true (or automatically when any of the ids is a depot, an HQ, or has a per-id building limit > 0 - GoalBuildId.as:50) the goal re-scans the buildings already on the map at activation time and counts them. The remaining constructor arguments (storeCategory, storeSubcategory, storePosition, eTrainBuilding) are pure UI hints used by PopupGoals to deep-link into the store or the training screen; they have no effect on completion.

goalTypes.trigger: Base.Iso.elementBuilt.
goalTypes.progressMetric: Count of built elements carrying a given item property (PropertyManager.WORKER, FARM, DECORATION, TOWER).
goalTypes.completionCondition: _currentStep >= steps.
goalTypes.notes: updateOnActivate makes the goal re-scan the existing buildings at activation time (GoalBuildProperty.as:28-37). Used for goal 8 (train 2 workers), 19 (train 2 more workers), 3 (build 1 farm), 27 (build 3 decorations) and 80 (build 8 towers).

goalTypes.trigger: Base.Iso.elemCollected, dispatched when the player collects from a building/resource node (core/isoengine/IsoEngine.as:566).
goalTypes.progressMetric: Count of collect events on elements that have the given property (RESOURCE for veins and trees, DEPOT for factories) and whose building.collect_type equals the resource code.
goalTypes.completionCondition: _currentStep >= steps.
goalTypes.notes: Resource codes come from Constants.COST_*: 'g' gold, 'w' wood, 'o' oil, 's' steel. Goal 5 = 1 wood, 28 = 7 wood, 23 = 3 gold, 50 = 10 gold, 29 = 10 oil, 14 = 3 steel; goals 21/54/53 = 1 collection from the gold/oil/steel factory.

goalTypes.trigger: ChapterManager.chapterFinished (Signal(int)) or, at activation, the already-completed check Base.Main.currentQuestId > chapterId (core/goals/GoalCompleteChapter.as:32-40).
goalTypes.progressMetric: Binary.
goalTypes.completionCondition: The dispatched chapter id equals the goal's chapter id.
goalTypes.notes: Chapter ids come from ChapterManager: 1 = CHAPTER_01_KEY, 2 = CHAPTER_02_GUILLE, 3 = CHAPTER_03_BAZOOKA, 4 = CHAPTER_04_JEEPS, 5 = CHAPTER_05_SIEGE_CONVENTIONAL, 6 = CHAPTER_06_MEGATANK, 7 = CHAPTER_07_SIEGE_ELEPHANT, 8 = CHAPTER_08_LURKER, 9 = CHAPTER_09_SIMPLE. The client ships 9 chapters (Config.NUM_CHAPTERS = 9, core/Config.as:156) but the goal texts of ids 130/138/145/150 refer to chapters 9/10/11/12, and the texts for the real chapters 5-8 live under the six never-registered text ids 98/105/114/122/128/140. The spawnChapter flag (only goal 17) additionally opens the mission briefing when the goal popup is closed.

goalTypes.trigger: Quest.questEnd (Signal(Object)) or, at activation, the already-completed check Base.Player.questsRank[Quest.questIds.indexOf(questId)] != undefined (core/goals/GoalCompleteQuest.as:28-38).
goalTypes.progressMetric: Binary.
goalTypes.completionCondition: The quest that ended has the goal's quest id, its difficulty is >= minDifficulty, and (when winRequired) it was won.
goalTypes.notes: Quest ids are Quest.QUEST_* strings '100000001'..'100000012' (missions) plus the hardcore series. minDifficulty defaults to 1 and winRequired defaults to true; GoalManager never overrides them, so every registered quest goal requires a win at difficulty >= 1. The play order is Quest.questIds (quest/Quest.as:192): [WEEKLY_01, QUEST_01, QUEST_06, QUEST_03, QUEST_04, QUEST_05, QUEST_02, QUEST_07, QUEST_08, QUEST_09, QUEST_10, QUEST_11, QUEST_12, ...]. Quests 02 and 06 therefore carry constant names that do not match their play position, and the goal texts (which use the play position) look 'swapped' against the constant names - but are not.

goalTypes.trigger: Composite goal: it owns a list of sub-goals and subscribes to their progress and complete signals.
goalTypes.progressMetric: currentStep is the SUM of the sub-goals' currentStep; numSteps is the SUM of their numSteps.
goalTypes.completionCondition: isCompleted() is true only when EVERY sub-goal is completed.

reward.notes: Not a registered goal type - no reward is ever attached to it.

goalTypes.notes: Not instantiated anywhere in GoalManager (0 registered goals) - it exists for the tutorial/mission chain and is rendered by PopupGoals through the SubGoal1/2/3 movie clips.

goalTypes.trigger: Base.Iso.dailyBounsWon (Signal(int, BuildingReference)) - the daily bonus bag was claimed.
goalTypes.progressMetric: Count of daily-bonus claims.
goalTypes.completionCondition: _currentStep >= day.
goalTypes.notes: The constructor sets _currentStep = 1, so goal 48 (GET DAILY BONUS!, day = 3) needs only 2 further claims after activation. The day count is NOT derived from a calendar in the client.

goalTypes.trigger: Base.Iso.doubleClick, dispatched from IsoInteractiveElement.doubleClickItem (core/isoengine/IsoInteractiveElement.as:733).
goalTypes.progressMetric: Count of double-clicks on the map.
goalTypes.completionCondition: _currentStep >= 1.
goalTypes.notes: Goal 16 (DOUBLE CLICK). No object-type filter: any double-click counts.

goalTypes.trigger: Base.Iso.tilePurchased, dispatched by IsoTerrain when a map tile is bought (core/isoengine/IsoTerrain.as:563).
goalTypes.progressMetric: Count of purchased tiles.
goalTypes.completionCondition: _currentStep >= steps. Goal 63 (EXPAND 1 MORE ACRE) requires 1 purchase.
goalTypes.notes: The payload is the tile id, which the goal ignores.

goalTypes.trigger: Quest.questEnd, or the already-completed check Base.Player.questsRank[1] != undefined (core/goals/GoalHarbor.as:28).
goalTypes.progressMetric: Binary.
goalTypes.completionCondition: Any quest ending completes the goal (the handler does not look at the quest id).
goalTypes.notes: Goal 26 (THE BAZOOKA KILLER (MISSION 1)). Side effect: when the goal popup is closed the goal spawns 12 'unallied' units next to the small harbour (queued as CmdBuy) and plays the first-mission cutscene.

goalTypes.trigger: Base.Iso.marketTrade, dispatched by PopupMarket.onTrade with the trade payload (popups/PopupMarket.as:101).
goalTypes.progressMetric: Per-resource cumulative traded volume. A positive target means 'buy' and a negative target means 'sell'; a trade only counts when the sign matches and |traded| >= |target|, and the remaining target is decremented otherwise.
goalTypes.completionCondition: tradesAlreadyMade == tradesLength, i.e. every requested resource amount has been traded in the right direction.

goalTypes.trigger: Base.Resources.playerStatsModified, dispatched by ResourceManager whenever the player's resource vector changes (managers/ResourceManager.as:175, 252, 298).
goalTypes.progressMetric: Per-resource cumulative delta, matched against the requested deltas with the same sign/magnitude rule as GoalMarketTrade.
goalTypes.completionCondition: statsAlreadyModified >= statsLength.
goalTypes.notes: Goal 45 (SPEND 1 CASH) uses {"c":-1}: the player must *lose* 1 cash. NOTE: the handler also executes this.stats[key] -= delta after the key was deleted (GoalModifyPlayerStats.as:56), which re-creates the key with the value NaN; the goal still completes, but the remaining-target bookkeeping is not clean.

goalTypes.trigger: Base.Iso.buildingMoved, dispatched by Base when a building is relocated with the move tool (core/Base.as:3980).
goalTypes.progressMetric: Count of moved buildings carrying the given property.
goalTypes.completionCondition: _currentStep >= steps. Goal 32 (MOVE A WALL) requires 1 wall move.
goalTypes.notes: The signal is dispatched for the selected building; the goal filters on property 'wall' and PLAYER_SELF.

goalTypes.trigger: Base.PopUp.popupOpened, dispatched whenever a popup is opened.
goalTypes.progressMetric: Binary.
goalTypes.completionCondition: The opened popup class equals the goal's popup class.
goalTypes.notes: Goal 47 = open the inventory popup (PopupInventory), goal 58 = open the assault history popup (PopupAssaultHistory).

goalTypes.trigger: Base.Iso.unitPopped, dispatched when a unit is removed from a building (core/isoengine/IsoEngine.as:551).
goalTypes.progressMetric: Count of units taken out of a matching building.
goalTypes.completionCondition: _currentStep >= steps. Goal 13 (GET WORKER OUT OF GOLD FACTORY) requires 1.
goalTypes.notes: The building filter accepts an id list, a delegate class or a property; the unit filter accepts an id list or a property. PLAYER_SELF is enforced for both.

goalTypes.trigger: Base.Iso.unitPushed, dispatched when a unit enters a building (core/isoengine/IsoEngine.as:556).
goalTypes.progressMetric: Count of units placed into a matching building.
goalTypes.completionCondition: _currentStep >= steps. Every registered GoalPushUnit requires exactly 1.
goalTypes.notes: Goals 20/10/43/88 = put a worker into a wood/gold/steel/oil factory (all four levels of each factory count), 4 = put a worker into a farm, 37 = put a ground unit into a bunker.

goalTypes.trigger: Base.Player.populationModified.
goalTypes.progressMetric: The ABSOLUTE current population (Base.Player.iPopulationCurrent), not a counter. The constructor already seeds _currentStep with the current population.
goalTypes.completionCondition: _currentStep >= target population. Goal 49 (REACH POPULATION 40) requires 40.
goalTypes.notes: The handler only updates the counter while Base.Main.gameMode == Constants.GAME_MODE_NORMAL (1), so population changes made while visiting a neighbour or during an assault do not count.

goalTypes.trigger: Base.Iso.timeSelected, dispatched when the player picks a production time on a multi-collectable building (core/isoengine/IsoEngine.as:561).
goalTypes.progressMetric: Count of time selections on a matching building.
goalTypes.completionCondition: _currentStep >= steps. Every registered GoalSelectTime requires 1.
goalTypes.notes: A selection matches when the element has the building property, its collect_type equals the resource code, and the chosen slot index (loaded.attrs.cp) is >= timeIdx. timeIdx is 0 in every registered goal, so any slot qualifies.

goalTypes.trigger: Base.Iso.socialBuildingOpened, dispatched when a social building is opened (core/isoengine/IsoBuilding.as:1136 for the Allies Market, core/isoengine/delegates/buildings/AlliesBuildingDelegate.as:27 for the Allies Building).
goalTypes.progressMetric: Binary.
goalTypes.completionCondition: The opened building's item id equals the goal's building id.
goalTypes.notes: Goal 71 (CALL FOR REINFORCEMENTS) targets ID_BUILDING_ALLIES_BUILDING (item id 61). The goal does not check PLAYER_SELF.

goalTypes.trigger: Assault.spyEnd, dispatched with the spied player's profile object when the spy popup is closed (battle/Assault.as:667).
goalTypes.progressMetric: Count of completed spy operations.
goalTypes.completionCondition: _currentStep >= steps. Goal 64 (USE RECON CENTER) requires 1.
goalTypes.notes: The handler skips events whose payload has a truthy 'voluntary' field, but the spy payload (a player profile) has no such field, so every spy end counts.

goalTypes.trigger: Base.Iso.itemStored, dispatched when a building is moved into storage (core/Base.as:4982).
goalTypes.progressMetric: Count of stored items matching the property or the id list.
goalTypes.completionCondition: _currentStep >= steps. Goal 60 (STORE A DECORATION) requires 1 decoration.
goalTypes.notes: VERIFIED BUG: deactivate() calls Base.Iso.itemStored.add(this.onItemStored) instead of .remove(...) (core/goals/GoalStoreItem.as:46), so the listener is never detached and a duplicate is registered on every deactivation.

goalTypes.trigger: Base.Iso.neighbourVisited, dispatched with the visited friend's id when the player enters a neighbour's map (core/Base.as:6887).
goalTypes.progressMetric: Count of visited neighbours.
goalTypes.completionCondition: If a friend-id list is supplied the visited id must be in the list; otherwise every visit counts. The step count is 1 when the third constructor argument is true, otherwise the length of the id list.
goalTypes.notes: Goal 40 (VISIT YOUR GENERAL!) supplies the list [100000030, 100000031] with steps = 1. The signal is declared Signal(String) and Base.as dispatches a String, but the handler parameter is typed int, so AS3 coerces the numeric string before the comparison.

goalTypes.trigger: Not a goal. Base class of the reward objects; a Sprite that can be rendered in the goal-complete popup.
goalTypes.progressMetric: n/a.
goalTypes.completionCondition: n/a.

reward.notes: Not a registered goal type - no reward is ever attached to it.

goalTypes.notes: deliver() is a no-op in the base class; info() returns an empty string. The concrete rewards are delivered by AbstractGoal.deliverReward(), which then queues the 'complete_goal' command.

goalTypes.trigger: Not a goal. Reward that grants a building or a unit.
goalTypes.progressMetric: n/a - it holds an item id and an amount.
goalTypes.completionCondition: n/a.

reward.notes: Not a registered goal type - no reward is ever attached to it.

goalTypes.notes: deliver() creates a BuildingReference for the item and calls Base.Main.storeItem(), i.e. the item is placed in the player's storage. Not used by any registered goal in this client - all 134 goals are registered with the integer 10, which parseReward() converts into a RewardResource.

goalTypes.trigger: Not a goal. Reward that grants an amount of one resource.
goalTypes.progressMetric: n/a - it holds a resource code (Constants.COST_*) and an amount.
goalTypes.completionCondition: n/a.

reward.notes: Not a registered goal type - no reward is ever attached to it.

goalTypes.notes: deliver() shows a floating particle; the actual grant travels with the 'complete_goal' command (commands/CmdCompleteGoal.as), which forwards the amount and the resource code. All 134 goals use RewardResource(COST_GOLD, 10) = 10 gold.

goals.title: BUILD A HOUSE
goals.description: Houses allow you to increase the max population (little black guy icon at the top-right of the screen) you can put on your camp. The more houses, the more soldiers you'll be able to train!
goals.instructions: Go to 'BUILD > Buildings > Houses' and click on 'House I'. Then put it on the map.

goals.title: BUILD A WOOD FACTORY
goals.description: You need wood to train soldiers and construct buildings. The wood factory will help you on this purpose!
goals.instructions: Go to 'BUILD > Buildings > Factories' and click on the 'Wood Factory I'. Then put it on the map.

goals.title: LET'S ZOOM!
goals.description: Zoom is very useful to see what's on your map.
goals.instructions: Move the wheel on the mouse or the slider on the botton right of the screen.

goals.title: TRAIN 2 WORKERS
goals.description: You need workers to work on the factories. Let's train some of them!
goals.instructions: Click on the Command Center and then click 2 times on the 'BUY FOR' button on the lower interface to train 2 of them.

goals.title: SEND 1 WORKER TO WOOD FACTORY
goals.description: Send the worker to the wood factory to start producing some wood!
goals.instructions: Click on a worker and then click on the wood factory.

goals.title: SELECT WORKING TIME
goals.description: You can set how long the working schedule of your workers will be.
goals.instructions: Click on the Wood Factory and select one of the options displayed in the pop-up window to produce wood.
goals.configTitle: Bring a villager to the mill

goals.title: EXTRACT 3 GOLD
goals.description: You need gold to train soldiers and construct buildings! Look for gold veins on the map and get more gold.
goals.instructions: Select a worker and click on a gold vein on the map to mine it. Remember you can zoom in/out on the map using the mouse wheel.

goals.title: BUILD A GOLD FACTORY
goals.description: The Gold Factory will provide you with nice amounts of gold!
goals.instructions: Go to 'BUILD > Buildings > Factories' and click on the 'Gold Factory I'. Then put it on the map.

goals.title: SEND WORKER TO GOLD FACTORY
goals.description: To start making gold, we need to tell workers to go to the factory!
goals.instructions: Click on a worker and then click on the gold factory.

goals.title: SELECT WORKING TIME
goals.description: You can set how long the working schedule of your workers will be.
goals.instructions: Click on the Gold Factory and select one of the options displayed in the pop-up window to produce gold.

goals.title: BUILD BAZOOKA ACADEMY
goals.description: A Bazooka Academy will let you train Bazooka soldiers. This will greatly improve your army!!
goals.instructions: Go to 'BUILD > Attack > Soldiers' and click on the 'Bazooka Academy I'. Then put it on your map.

goals.title: TRAIN 3 LIGHT BAZOOKA
goals.description: Let's train some light bazooka soldiers!
goals.instructions: Click on the Bazooka Academy and then click 3 times on the 'BUY FOR' button at the lower interface.

goals.title: DOUBLE CLICK
goals.description: Double-clicking is super useful to select units at once.
goals.instructions: Select the soldiers you just trained with a double click.
goals.configTitle: Bring a sheep to the ranch

goals.title: RESCUE YOUR COMRADES!
goals.description: It's time to fight, soldier! Defeat all the enemies and free our soldiers who were taken hostage by the enemy!
goals.instructions: Defeat all the enemies on the map to save your soldiers!

goals.title: TRAIN 2 MORE WORKERS
goals.description: Let's train some workers for coming tasks.
goals.instructions: Click on the Command Center and then on the BUY FOR button on the lower interface to train a worker.

goals.title: CUT TREES AND GET WOOD
goals.description: Wood is vital to construct buildings and train units!
goals.instructions: Click on a worker and then on a tree. Then get the wood!

goals.title: BUILD A STEEL FACTORY
goals.description: Steel is needed to construct buildings and units.
goals.instructions: Go to 'BUILD > Buildings > Factories' and click on the 'Steel Factory I'. Then put it on the map.

goals.title: ADD WORKER TO STEEL FACTORY
goals.description: The steel factory needs a worker to start producing steel.
goals.instructions: Select a worker and then click on the steel factory.

goals.title: SELECT STEEL TO BUILD
goals.description: Choose how much steel you want at the set time.
goals.instructions: Click on the Steel Factory and select one of the options to produce steel.

goals.title: CALL YOUR ALLIES!
goals.description: If you have allies, you'll have more fun and it will be much easier for you to get resources, units or open buildings!
goals.instructions: Select some of your friends and click on the 'SEND INVITE' button.

goals.title: VISIT YOUR GENERAL!
goals.description: Visit the General's portrait to see how it's going on his camp!
goals.instructions: Click on the General portrait at the lower interface.
goals.notes: The friend-id list [100000030, 100000031] is compared against a String payload that AS3 coerces to int. UNVERIFIED: which friends those two ids are is not determinable from the client.

goals.title: BUILD 2 TURRETS NEAR COMMAND CENTER
goals.description: Turrets are very effective defensive means against both ground and flying enemies!
goals.hint: If you click on a turret once it is put on the map, a dynamic radius will display its shooting range!
goals.instructions: Go to 'BUILD > Defense > Turrets' and click on the 'Turret I'. Then put it on your map.

goals.title: BUILD A WALL
goals.description: Walls are very effective to difficult ground units from entering your camp.
goals.instructions: Go to 'BUILD > Defense > Walls and click on the 'Wall I'. Then put it on your map.
goals.configTitle: Put a name to your Empire

goals.title: MOVE A WALL
goals.description: Reallocating your buildings, decorations, turrets, etc is very easy!
goals.instructions: Click on the MultiTool at the lower right interface to unfold different cursor options. Select the MOVE icon and then click on a Wall to move it.

goals.title: BUILD A CORN FIELD
goals.description: Field we'll provide you with gold quite easily!
goals.instructions: Go to 'BUILD > Buildings > Fields & Farms' and click on 'Corn Field'. Then put it on the map.
goals.configTitle: Send a villager to the farm

goals.title: SEND WORKER TO FIELD
goals.description: Don't let your workers be idle, otherwise they will become lazier and lazier!
goals.instructions: Select a worker and then click on the Corn Field you built before.

goals.title: GET WORKER OUT OF GOLD FACTORY
goals.description: Sometimes you may need a worker to perform other tasks. That's why you can also get them out from factories.
goals.instructions: Click on the Gold Factory, and click on the worker's portrait at the lower interface.

goals.title: EXTRACT 3 STEEL
goals.description: Steel will allow you to construct Buildings, and this means more and better units to win the war!
goals.instructions: Click on a worker and then click again on a steel vein on your map.

goals.title: THE BAZOOKA KILLER (MISSION 1)
goals.description: There's a nearby enemy that is plotting to attack us. Let's fight now before he reaches us!
goals.instructions: Click on the World icon at the lower right and click on 'Missions World'. Now choose the first mission!
goals.notes: Side effect: closing the goal popup spawns 12 unallied units at the harbour and starts the first-mission cutscene (GoalHarbor.as:47-74).

goals.title: BUILD A BUNKER
goals.description: Bunkers are good deffensive means to protect your camp.
goals.instructions: Go to 'BUILD > Defense > Bunkers' and click on 'Bunker I'. Then put it on your map.

goals.title: MOVE UNIT TO BUNKER
goals.description: Bunkers are worth nothing unless you put soldiers inside them!
goals.instructions: Select a soldier and click on the bunker to put him inside it.

goals.title: COLLECT 10 OIL
goals.description: You need oil to construct buildings.
goals.instructions: Check the map and find some oil veins. Click on a worker and then on an oil vein to mine it.

goals.title: BUILD 4 MORE HOUSES
goals.description: Build more houses so you can mak your army bigger.
goals.instructions: Go to 'BUILD > Buildings > Houses' and click on 'House I'. Then put the 4 houses on the map.

goals.title: BUILD 3 DECORATIONS
goals.description: Decorations will make your soldiers and workers happier and proud to be part of your army!
goals.instructions: Go to 'BUILD > Decorations' and choose the decoration you like the most. Then put 3 of them on your map.

goals.title: CHOP DOWN 7 MORE TREES
goals.description: Chop down more trees to get wood so that you can train more units!
goals.instructions: Select a worker and then click on 7 trees. Then get the wood resources.

goals.title: BUILD A JEEP GARAGE
goals.description: Make your army more powerful building a Jeep Garage!
goals.instructions: Go to 'BUILD > Attack > Vehicles' and click on the 'Jeep Garage I'. Then put it on your map.

goals.title: TRAIN 3 MACHINE GUN JEEPS
goals.description: Let's build some Machine Gun Jeeps!
goals.instructions: Click on the 'Jeep Garage I' and then click 3 times on the 'BUY FOR' button at the lower interface.

goals.title: BUILD AN OIL FACTORY
goals.description: The Oil Factory will allow you to produce oil in order to build vehicles.

reconciliation.notes: The client registers 134 goals (managers/GoalManager.as:49-315); every id is unique. config/main.json contains 91 goals with ids 1..91 (contiguous). 79 ids exist in both places, 12 ids exist only in the config and 55 ids only in the client. IMPORTANT: the numeric overlap is coincidental. The config's goal table is NOT Social Wars content - its titles talk about villagers, trolls, sheep/cow ranches, wonders, acres, an archery range, a stable, a university and a blacksmith, none of which exist in the Social Wars client (whose goals are about workers, soldiers, factories, bunkers and turrets). The same file's items array IS Social Wars content (House I, Wood Factory I, ...), so the goals array is foreign/stale data in the upstream snapshot; it is byte-identical in all three captured config snapshots (get_game_config.php_23july2012.txt, ..._29august2012.txt, ..._29august2012_nohash.txt). The upstream Python server reads this table (get_game_config.py:139-150) and prints its title when a set_goals/complete_goal command arrives (command.py:68-79), so it prints unrelated titles. The id space itself IS shared, though: the 12 config-only ids (2, 7, 12, 15, 35, 38, 68, 75, 76, 77, 78, 83) are exactly the ids that are missing from BOTH the client registrations and TranslationGoals, which means the client simply never implemented those goals, and the config table does carry the same id space. All 91 config goals have reward = 10, which matches the client's uniform 10-gold reward.
